description: Shared ABI and interface fixture for the payment_escrow Soroban contract

functions.name: create
functions.doc: Create a new escrow, locking amount from payer for beneficiary in token asset

functions.name: release
functions.doc: Release all remaining locked escrowed funds to beneficiary

functions.name: refund
functions.doc: Refund all remaining locked funds back to payer

functions.name: release_partial
functions.doc: Release a specified amount from escrow to beneficiary

functions.name: refund_remaining
functions.doc: Refund any remaining balance back to payer

functions.name: get_status
functions.doc: Query numeric status of an escrow (1=Locked, 2=Released, 3=Refunded, 4=Completed)

functions.name: get_escrow
functions.doc: Query full escrow struct from persistent storage

functions.name: initialize
functions.doc: One-time setup to record the admin address

functions.name: version
functions.doc: Interface version reported by the contract

functions.name: upgrade
functions.doc: Replace contract code with new WASM hash (admin only)

functions.name: propose_admin
functions.doc: Step one of two-step admin transfer

functions.name: accept_admin
functions.doc: Step two of two-step admin transfer

functions.name: pause
functions.doc: Emergency stop for create entrypoint (admin only)

functions.name: unpause
functions.doc: Lift the pause on create entrypoint (admin only)

functions.name: is_paused
functions.doc: Check whether contract is currently paused
